summary: Certified Human Resources Professional with 15 years of experience in full HR functions, including employee management, hiring, training, and compliance. Skilled in integrating HR practices to achieve business results.

experience.title: HR Consultant
responsibilities: Partnered with legal department of a multi‑state client (40,000+ employees) to establish ADAAA and other workplace compliance.
Identified and updated backlog of LOA and accommodation issues.

experience.title: Human Resource Specialist
responsibilities: Advised diverse clients on HR solutions and compliance with state and federal laws.
Designed performance evaluation and merit programs.
Implemented exit interview and interview programs.
Created and modified job descriptions across departments.
Developed employee handbooks and training materials.
Managed confidential personnel records and background checks.
Recruited and interviewed applicants, increasing workforce by a significant percentage.
Implemented incentive programs that boosted productivity.

experience.title: Human Resource Generalist
responsibilities: Interpreted and implemented company policy with focus on employment law.
Coached managers on employee relations and performance management.
Acted as liaison during organizational process changes.
Managed leaves of absence, workers’ compensation, and I‑9 compliance.
Created compliance rectification processes.

experience.title: Human Resources Coordinator
responsibilities: Supported HR for 3 sites with over 600 employees.
Managed LOA including FMLA, CFRA, and PDL.
Coached on compliance, employee relations, and disciplinary actions.
Responded to EDD, FEHA, and hotline complaints, avoiding litigation.
Developed training programs to reduce turnover and improve productivity.
Implemented Oracle HR and managed compensation surveys.
Conducted new hire orientation and harassment prevention training.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
responsibilities: Provided general support to HR department and director.
Managed company events, recreation programs, and benefits inquiries.
